pages.title: Swimming Home
pages.text: Eat a Voidseeker and successfully return to your respawn point through its native effect.

pages.title: Swimming Home
pages.text: Use a special catch as a way to return home.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A native return must succeed; an unrelated teleport does not count. Another special catch, the Chasm Eel, interacts with bedrock only when the server explicitly allows it.

pages.title: Use a special catch
pages.text: Voidseeker returns you to your respawn point. Chasm Eel interacts with bedrock only when the server explicitly permits it; acquiring the fish and enabling its ability are separate questions.
